t: The Bubble That Can't Burst: Why AI is a Strange Loop, Not a Dot-Com Repeat
s: AI's self-improving intelligence commodity creates a positive feedback loop, unlike finite dot-com era resources, preventing a bubble and enabling continuous capability growth through 'Strange Loops'.
sub: AI as a self-improving commodity vs. finite dot-com resources
Data center infrastructure build-out and consolidation dynamics
The 'Strange Loop' concept driving AI advancement
Practical demonstration of AI debugging and workflow enhancement
